decisions.what: Harness options: A (static pairwise suite) + C (vision-assert benchmarks) adopted; B (agent-generated nightly instances) deferred until A is green and boring. Reporting: kflow test:start/test:verdict onto the shared retest grid.

qa/ folder is the QA home inside the app: JSON = source of truth under git change-control, HTML pages = static viewers hydrating from it. Bug fix + its test case should land in the same commit wherever possible.

QA home reorganised into three layers: Documentation (static-ish) / Configuration (slow-moving JSON, git change-controlled) / Results (live retest grid + manual-run recorder). Manual runs are recorded as kflow test:start/test:verdict checkpoints — the SAME convention katrun uses — via the existing /kflow endpoint, so all testing speaks one language and the backend kflow-admin sees frontend runs too (KFLOW_FE_DIRS).
